fusions.name: Pitch-Pine Brand
fusions.desc: A weapon strike with one of your own limbs lit as a brand: it deals 8 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Serotinous Cone
fusions.desc: Throws a resin-sealed cone that deals 28 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then bursts open in the heat, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Charred Rind
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spotting Embers
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, an ember leaps from it to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 6 damage. It sets that enemy [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
